name: print-social-cage-poster-with-vertical-bars-and-rotated-type
title: Black-and-white barred poster with a giant rotated 'CAGE' and red rotated poem text
whatItIs: A poster where vertical black and white bars sit between orange edges, a huge grey rotated 'CAGE' with a red C is sliced by the bars, and small rotated paragraphs in white and red sit in the black bars.
whatItMeans: Confining and tense; the bars literally cage the word.
techniques: Slice giant type with bars to imply a cage.
Rotate text 90 degrees inside the bars.

vocabulary.definition: One letter in a contrasting colour.
Type layouts that illustrate the meaning of the words.
